public static final class PluginApiServiceGrpc.PluginApiServiceBlockingStub extends io.grpc.stub.AbstractBlockingStub<PluginApiServiceGrpc.PluginApiServiceBlockingStub>
A stub to allow clients to do limited synchronous rpc calls to service PluginApiService. 
Discovers typed APIs registered by SoulFire server plugins.
